description: This file is the entry point for a React application. It imports React and ReactDOM libraries, applies CSS styling, imports the main App component, and renders it inside the DOM element with id 'root' using React's createRoot API with StrictMode.

methods.name: createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React root for rendering the React application into the DOM.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the React element tree into the DOM within the created root.
